youtube.title: Why Soap Bubbles Swirl With Colors 🫧 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Soap bubbles are made of clear water, clear soap and clear air, yet they shimmer with colors. The wall of a bubble is a film hundreds of times thinner than a human hair. Light reflects off both its outer and inner surface, and the two reflections interfere, boosting some colors and cancelling others depending on the thickness of the film. This effect is called thin-film interference.
